SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-16-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF LESLI GADDY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS JOHN MONTEJANO AND JUAN MANUEL COVARRUBIAS ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOHN MONTEJANO WAIVES SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. THIS MATTER IS HEARD CONSECUTIVELY WITH THE RELATED CASE OF CSM-20-863718 HEIDE LYNN LIZARBE, VS. JOHN MONTEJANO. JOHN MONTEJANO SERVES AS INTERPRETER FOR HIS FATHER JUAN MANUEL COVARRUBIAS FROM ENGLISH TO SPANISH. INTERPRETER OATH IS GIVEN TO JOHN MONTEJANO. PLAINTIFF'S STATE IN OPEN COURT THAT THE CORRECT ADDRESS FOR PLAINTIFFS IS 182 PADDON PLACE APT. 10, MARINA, CA 93933. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GADDY, LESLIE (PASSENGER) RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT COVARRUBIAS, JUAN MANUEL (RO) $3,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $185.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,185.00, DEFENDANT JOHN MONTEJANO IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
